name: TOGAF EPIC SAD v2 - full pipeline contract (executed by scripts/togaf_epic.py)
description: Declarative contract for the Phase-2+ EPIC SAD build. This manifest is the governed record of WHAT the pipeline does and its quality gates; scripts/togaf_epic.py is the deterministic executor (benny run executes only the narrative half via togaf_epic_sad_swarm.json). Doctrine: diagrams are NEVER produced by an LLM - they are pure functions of graph/disk truth; the swarm narrates around them.

phases.detail: CIM CPU/RAM/GPU + Ryzen AI NPU detect + LAN inference host probe (reachability + served models). Declared rig matrix kept in scripts/togaf_epic_declared_hardware.json, separate from probes.
Fixed 3-prompt set fired at each rig (LM Studio eGPU LAN + lemonade NPU local); wall time, completion tokens, median tok/s. Like-for-like, raw data in evidence pack.
Models-tested table from run records + LONGVIEW execution register (real durations/tokens).
Neo4j label/relationship introspection + per-label property keys + real edge-pair counts.
CodeEntity census, top classes by DEFINES method count, DEPENDS_ON area pairs, CORRELATES_WITH strategy split.
Real swarm AER events from the governance ledger drive the sequence diagram.
Evidence pack archived per run under togaf_epic_evidence/history/<run>; build-over-build delta chapter (label counts, deps, services) computed against the previous archive.

10+ mermaid diagrams generated from evidence: C4 context/container, use-case per channel, BPMN-style pipeline, class (real method counts), sequence (real run), ER (real edge counts), data conceptual/logical/physical (real property keys + measured store sizes), deployment topology (probed rigs).
19-persona enterprise narrative (use cases, BPMN prose, C4 prose, behavioural UML prose, data architecture, NFR, security, devsecops, deployment, observability, gap/transition, ADRs).

Narrative split into chapters; each chapter interleaved with its authoritative diagrams (CHAPTER_MAP); per-chapter word floor (${word_floor_per_chapter}) enforced and reported in a gates table. Unclaimed diagrams still ship.
Minimum hardware requirements DERIVED with the arithmetic shown (model bytes/param + KV cache + measured stores), never asserted.

Epic markdown: evidence + diagrams + woven narrative + observability/lineage/logging + hardware + models + delta + gates + reproducibility appendix. Honest census (words, diagrams, sections, gate failures).

scripts/togaf_epic_pdf.mjs: md -> HTML (tables + mermaid via vendored scripts/vendor/mermaid.min.js) -> headless Edge/Chrome print. VALIDATION GATE: dump-dom counts rendered SVGs; every mermaid block must render as a real non-error SVG or the build FAILS (exit 1). Output: ${output_pdf} with diagrams REALIZED, not code.

observability.events: Every phase emits TASK_METADATA_UPDATE (swarm_workflow shape) to runtime/workspace/governance.log; the build appears in the :8788/lineage.html register with live AER step-through.
observability.openlineage: Swarm half emits OpenLineage 1-0-5 RunEvents; openlineage_runtime.json downloadable from the dashboard.
